newsitem.title: SPAIN: Breakdown of IFC six tranche peseta bond.
newsitem.headline: Breakdown of IFC six tranche peseta bond.

text.p: The following is a breakdown of the International Finance Corporation 38 billion peseta six tranche equity linked bond, annouced by lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell on Monday:
Amount: 38 billion pesetas in six tranches, including five for 6.333 billion peseta and the sixth for 6.335 billion.
All tranches will receive in addition to the redemption amount and coupons, a 157.9 percent revaluation against a basket of indices which include the FTSE, DAX, CAC and IBEX indices.
Coupons: First year: 2 percent, second year: 3 percent, third year: 4 percent, fourth year: 5 percent, fifth year: 6 percent, sixth year: 7 percent
Coupons: First year: 5 percent, second to fifth years: 4 percent, sixth year: 6 percent
Coupons: 4.5 percent during life of issue
Coupons: 4.3 percent during life of issue
Coupons: First, second, third years: 4 percent; last three years: 5 percent.
Coupons: First and second years: 4.7 percent; last four years: 4.2 percent.
